title: WRK-1 — Published Series Documentation Coverage Report Delivery
summary: deliver the local Series-grained Works report over exact Series and member-Work Project document subjects
content_html:
WRK-1 — Published Series Documentation Coverage Report Delivery

Status

WRK-1.1 is implemented and parked at its review gate. The focused browser module, local registry/loader wiring, external report host, and focused tests are complete without a new server or public seam. WRK-1.2 verification, durable-owner transfer, and closeout require explicit approval.

Complete Result

An ordinary local report-host document titled Works in scope dotlineform renders one Series | Docs row for every exact Series classified as published in canonical source and carried by the Studio Series search projection. Series titles link to the exact Series page on the configured local site preview. Docs link to exact dotlineform/projects documents and retain the shared Series or Work subject cue.

For a published Series, Docs is the deduplicated union of exact valid Series-subject documents for that series_id and exact valid Work-subject documents for published Works whose current canonical series_ids includes that Series. Any one document makes the Series written about; draft Works contribute no coverage, and other undocumented member Work IDs do not create gaps. Rows with no document remain present with a blank Docs cell.

Why This Matters Now

Project State, Projects, and Works become three deliberately different views over the folders-Series-documents relationship:

  • Project State begins with physical folders;
  • Projects begins with Project documents; and
  • Works begins with published Series.

The third view exposes Series with no written coverage without widening Project State, restoring a Studio reporting obligation, or displaying private Projects associations on the public site.

Project State currently retains canonical Work/Series relationships without a publication-status filter. WRK-1 does not alter that existing contract. Restricting the folder-first report to published Series would be a separate Project State refinement.

Delivery Boundary

WRK-1 includes:

  • browser reads of the existing Studio Series and Work search projections through the current Local Studio Catalogue read boundary;
  • a browser read of the current private Projects Manage manifest, with no second subject-association input;
  • exact published-Series and published-Work filtering plus exact current series_ids membership;
  • one local registry/loader/browser-module path and one ordinary external-local report host;
  • frontend-only filtering, joining, de-duplication, ordering, and table composition;
  • a two-column Series/Docs table with exact local-preview and Projects links;
  • shared Series/Work subject cues, deterministic ordering, empty rows, automatic mount, full-input refresh, and contained current-mount failure;
  • focused input-contract, registry/loader, module, external-host, and local/public-isolation evidence; and
  • transfer of shipped behavior to the durable coverage and reporting owners.

WRK-1 excludes:

  • Work-grained rows, per-Work gap reporting, completeness scores, or a requirement that every member Work be documented;
  • Folder subjects, semantic-token mentions, content comparison, title/filename inference, or unknown-target fallback;
  • analysis/works, editorial/public lineage, publishable, public doc_url[], or public Work/Series page presentation;
  • public Catalogue JSON as a report input or publication authority, and Catalogue projection-integrity auditing;
  • a Works producer, persisted/versioned report response, Docs Viewer report-service method, or management route;
  • Project State response or presentation changes;
  • search, grouping, filters, clipboard/export, persisted results, saved report Markdown, watching, or mutation hooks;
  • a generic report engine, relationship database, compatibility alias, dual reader, or new canonical store; and
  • report-driven subject, Catalogue, Copy, Publish, or Delete mutations.

Likely Owners To Inspect

The sanity gate should inspect and narrow these current owners:

  • studio/services/catalogue/catalogue_lookup.py for the existing Series/Work search projection shapes and studio/app/server/studio/studio_catalogue_api.py only to confirm the existing read keys and loopback-origin transport; neither is expected to change;
  • the private Projects Manage manifest and docs-viewer/runtime/js/management/docs-viewer-management-subscope-dotlineform-projects.js for its normalized authoring_subject, existing Catalogue-title read pattern, preview URL composition, and shared subject cues;
  • docs-viewer/config/reports/reports.json and docs-viewer/runtime/js/reports/docs-viewer-reports.js for local report registration and explicit browser loading;
  • one new focused browser report module using the existing shared report table/link styles and project-subject-icons vocabulary; and
  • the Projects sub-scope and focused report-module smokes as browser-composition references, not as an invitation to create a generic report abstraction.

The expected implementation is roughly 250–350 production lines plus 250–400 focused test/smoke lines, one external report-host source, and small explicit registry/loader wiring. No Python report production or Docs Viewer route work is expected. WRK-1.0 must restate the final file list and estimate. Stop for review if the current Studio lookup reads or Projects manifest cannot supply the frozen inputs, or if the result needs new server transport, a general subject query service, shared mode-driven report framework, persisted coverage product, Project State refactor, public payload consumer, or materially larger footprint.

Delivery Steps

WRK-1.0 — Sanity And Contract Gate

  • [x] Reproduce the existing catalogue_lookup_series_search and catalogue_lookup_work_search browser payloads through the configured Local Studio base, including published/draft status, exact IDs, multi-Series membership, and loopback-origin access.
  • [x] Confirm that Series lookup status: published alone establishes rows and that only Work lookup records with status: published expand a Work-subject document through exact current series_ids.
  • [x] Confirm the private Projects Manage manifest already supplies every required document title, exact target, and normalized authoring_subject; do not add a subject-associations.json read.
  • [x] Confirm exact Project targets, shared subject-cue reuse, local-preview Series target composition from series_id, deterministic ordering, blank-row behavior, and complete-input failure handling.
  • [x] Confirm the browser module needs no public Catalogue JSON, report response schema, report-service method, management route, or new Studio read key. If current transport is insufficient, stop and review that seam rather than adding it implicitly.
  • [x] State the exact production, external-source, and focused-test files, refined line estimate, primary risks, and scope-creep stop condition.

Gate: Record the bounded findings in this delivery or a temporary child note and stop for implementation approval. Documentation completion is not runtime completion.

WRK-1.0 Record

The configured Local Studio reads returned studio_catalogue_lookup_series_search_v1 with 143 exact Series records and studio_catalogue_lookup_work_search_v1 with 1,940 exact Work records. Both responses included published and draft status, the Work response retained current series_ids, and a request from the configured Docs Viewer loopback origin received the matching cross-origin response header. The current private Projects Manage manifest returned 241 exact child records with title, doc_id, and normalized authoring_subject; its exact collection is the configured dotlineform/projects, and document activation remains the existing Projects host d-20260801-073826-8865a8 plus exact subdoc.

A read-only composition over the current three inputs established 139 published-Series rows, of which 5 have one or more documents and 134 remain intentionally blank. Three Work-subject documents and two Series-subject documents contribute current coverage. Work 00008 demonstrates one exact document expanding through current membership to published Series 026 and 105; no Series row contained a duplicate document identity. The implementation must repeat this complete join after each refresh and clear the current result on any input or schema failure.

The exact hand-written production files for WRK-1.1 are:

  • new docs-viewer/runtime/js/reports/works-report.js for input validation, exact join, deterministic projection, complete refresh, contained failure, and Series/Docs rendering;
  • existing docs-viewer/config/reports/reports.json for one local works record;
  • existing docs-viewer/runtime/js/reports/docs-viewer-reports.js for one explicit works loader; and
  • new $DOTLINEFORM_PROJECTS_BASE_DIR/docs-viewer/scopes/dotlineform/source/documents/d-20260810-150346-bc7cdc.md for the ordinary local Works report host.

The focused evidence files are new docs-viewer/tests/python/test_works_report_contract.py and docs-viewer/tests/smoke/docs_viewer_works_report_modules.py. The contract test owns registry, loader, exact local input paths, Projects-host identity, and public/server/report-service absence. The module smoke owns schema rejection, published/draft filtering, Series and Work subject routing, multi-Series fan-out, de-duplication, ordering, exact links and icons, blank rows, three-read refresh, and complete failure replacement.

The refined estimate is 300–365 hand-written production lines including registry, loader, and report host, plus 320–420 focused test/smoke lines. Existing project-subject-icons.js, report table/link classes, scopeConfigs sub-scope projection, viewerUrlForScope, configured publicPreviewBase, and Local Studio JSON read transport are reused. No CSS, Python producer, report response, Docs Viewer service method, management route, Studio read key, public registry/loader, public Catalogue consumer, or Project State change is expected.

The primary risks are accepting near-match schemas or targets, treating draft/unknown Works as coverage, retaining a partial or stale join after one failed refresh, and accidentally coupling the exact Projects host to the currently selected document or default route. Stop before or during WRK-1.1 if the browser cannot obtain the three frozen inputs through these existing seams; if exact activation requires target inference, another read, or new configuration ownership; if implementation needs server-side composition, persistence, public data, CSS redesign, a generic report/relationship abstraction, or Project State changes; or if the footprint materially exceeds this estimate.

Focused verification after approval is the two new tests, JavaScript lint for the changed runtime files, the external dotlineform Docs/search rebuild and exact host projection check, Studio Docs/search rebuilds after durable owner transfer, bounded public-registry/public-runtime/server-route/report-service absence scans, git diff --check, and an independent named-delivery diff review.

WRK-1.1 — Deliver The Browser-Composed Local Report

  • [x] Add one focused Works browser module that loads the existing Series lookup, Work lookup, and Projects Manage manifest in parallel, validates their exact owned shapes, and replaces the current result only after all three reads succeed.
  • [x] Filter Series and Works to exact status: published, join exact Series/Work subjects through current series_ids, and validate identity, presentation, Projects targets, subject provenance, de-duplication, counts, deterministic ordering, and unknown/unusable input diagnostics without inferring rows or coverage.
  • [x] Register one local report ID and browser loader through the existing explicit report mechanism; add no report-service method or management route.
  • [x] Create one ordinary dotlineform parent report-host source titled Works with local access, concise explanatory Markdown, and no public projection.
  • [x] Render the Series | Docs table automatically on mount, with any refresh re-reading all three inputs, exact local-preview Series links, exact Projects document links, shared Series/Work subject cues, visible blank Docs cells, and contained current-mount failure.

Checkpoint: The local works registry entry and explicit loader mount one focused browser module. It validates the two exact lookup schemas and current Projects Manage manifest, filters only exact published records, joins normalized Series/Work subjects through current membership, sorts and de-duplicates exact identities, renders exact Series and Projects links with shared subject cues, and clears the current rows before every all-three-input refresh. The ordinary external-local host is d-20260810-150346-bc7cdc; its local by-ID, tree, Recent, and search projections exist with viewer_report: works, viewer_report_access: local, and no public projection.

Five focused contract tests, the browser-module smoke, Python and JavaScript lint, and git diff --check pass. The smoke proves published/draft filtering, blank rows, both subject routes, one Work fanning out to multiple published Series, exact de-duplication, stable ordering, exact targets and icons, strict near-match rejection, all-three-read refresh, and stale-result clearing on failure.

The retained implementation is 450 physical production lines: 420 in the focused module, 15 registry/loader lines, and 15 external-host source lines. This is 85 lines above the WRK-1.0 upper estimate because the browser module owns exact validation for three independent inputs, local-origin and activation-target validation, complete replacement, and contained rendering. The file list and ownership seams did not expand: there is still no CSS, Python producer, report service, management route, Studio read key, public runtime, public Catalogue consumer, generic report framework, persistence, or Project State change. Stop here for review of that bounded variance before WRK-1.2.

WRK-1.2 — Verify And Transfer

  • [ ] Prove published Series with no documents, one Series-subject document, one or several Work-subject documents, both subject levels, duplicate prevention, unknown subjects, a Work in several published Series, and a published Series containing many other undocumented Works.
  • [ ] Prove one matching document marks the Series written about without calculating or displaying uncovered member Work IDs.
  • [ ] Prove draft Series never establish rows, draft and unknown Works never contribute coverage, documents never invent rows, Series subjects never fan out, and published Work subjects expand only through exact current membership.
  • [ ] Prove exact site-preview Series targets, exact Projects subdoc targets, icon meaning, deterministic ordering, empty/failure states, complete refresh, external host generation, and local/public report isolation.
  • [ ] Prove the Works module reads neither public Catalogue JSON nor a Works server route and that no Works method enters docs-viewer-report-service.js.
  • [ ] Run focused registry/module smoke, JavaScript lint for changed source, generated external/Studio Docs checks, the bounded public-absence/server-absence scans, and git diff --check.
  • [ ] Update the durable Sub-Scope Publishing/reporting owners with shipped behavior, perform an independent code/diff review, and park the feature for closeout review without retiring delivery material.

Completion Gate

WRK-1 is complete only when every Studio lookup Series with exact published status appears once; a Series Project document or published-Work Project document reaches exactly the published Series rows defined by its declared subject and current membership; one matching document is sufficient coverage; blank rows remain visible; Series and document targets are exact; the report is browser-composed, read-only, local-only, and independently reachable; and focused evidence protects the input contracts, wiring, presentation, external host, and public/server isolation.

A Work-grained gap list, draft-Work coverage, hidden empty Series, semantic-mention coverage, title inference, document-created row, partial/stale input join, public Catalogue JSON read, public report exposure, analysis/works read, doc_url[] display, Works server producer/endpoint, Project State change, persisted coverage product, or mutation control is not a pass.
